Market today: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are driving oil prices higher weekly, creating broad market uncertainty. Coupled with fears of multiple Fed rate hikes, this creates a cautious environment, especially for your tech/chip-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.21%) and SPAL (-31.77%) are both leveraged ETFs in deep drawdowns with "SELL" statuses. QQQI (-3.22%) is also flagged for "TRIM." Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Middle East developments and any new Fed commentary on interest rates.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions and stay alert to macro headwinds for tech.
plays: Consider exiting SOXL given its "SELL" status, significant loss, and leveraged nature. This position carries amplified risk on margin.
Review SPAL for potential exit due to its "SELL" status, large drawdown, and leveraged risk. Managing this is crucial.
Trim QQQI as indicated by its "TRIM" status to reduce exposure. This helps manage overall portfolio risk.
